Open Data Ensemble

Council application

Seats are open on the Product, Technical, Community and So.Me. councils. You don't need to be an expert, and your contribution doesn't have to be code.

This takes about 20 minutes. When you finish, your answers are saved as a text file and your email app opens addressed to hello@opendataensemble.org. Attach the file and send. Applying does not guarantee a seat; the Governance Council votes on new members. Fields marked (required) must be filled in.
